name: Private sign-in form
note: User logs in, model never sees it
summary: When the agent hits a login, it pauses and hands the browser or a form to the user, who signs in directly. The model sees the logged-in session afterwards but never the password.
how: Agent reaches a sign-in page and pauses
User takes over and types credentials (or uses a password manager)
Screenshots and model input are suspended meanwhile
Agent resumes with the authenticated session
facts: ChatGPT agent (take over browser), 1Password for Claude (fills logins after approval)
Password stays private, but the session it unlocks does not
goodFor: Browser agents on sites without APIs
Accounts the user won't share with a vault
watchOut: The agent can do anything the session allows
Persisted cookies keep the session open across runs
